evidence.resource_admission_note: Both GPUs passed compact count-four finalizer qualification sequentially and concurrently under a 37.5 GiB shared fleet cap, with 18 GiB RAM and 14.25 GiB spill per worker. The laptop GPU received 12 Rayon threads, 7 GiB managed VRAM and 7.25 GiB context allowance; the desktop GPU received 11 threads, 5.5 GiB managed VRAM and 6 GiB context allowance. All completed worker and parent memory-event deltas were zero. Two earlier successful sequential roots and both rejected concurrent launches remain recorded. The revised allocation retains the additional 2 GiB reserve derived from physical RAM. The diagnostic before the successful retry found 44.792 GiB available against a 43.722 GiB requirement. Actual admission was checked again at launch. Exact-profile context calibration and repeated performance qualification remain pending.
